question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Run of the mill
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Run of the mill"** means something that is average or not special in any way; it is ordinary or commonplace. (साधारण)

 
 
• **Example: **The movie was just a **run of the mill **action flick, nothing special.
 
 
 
• **"Ordinary" **refers to something with no special or distinctive features; it is normal or usual. (सामान्य)
 
 
• **Example: **He led an** ordinary** life, with nothing out of the ordinary happening to him.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Ordinary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Antagonist **(विरोधी): A person who actively opposes or is hostile to someone or something; an adversary.

 
 
• **Example:** The protagonist faced many challenges from the antagonist in the story.
 
 
 
• **Caretaker **(देखभाल करने वाला): A person employed to look after a building or someone’s property.
 
 
• **Example: **The caretaker of the mansion ensured everything was in order.
 
 
 
• **Leader **(नेता): A person who leads or commands a group, organization, or country.
 
 
• **Example:** She was a natural leader who inspired others to follow her vision.
